sections.Aim and Purpose: Discussed sustainability risk assessments and their implications for supervised entities, equipping participants to address sustainability risk and integrate sustainable finance into day-to-day supervision.
sections.Intended Audience: Mid-level supervisory staff building capability in sustainable finance/ESG supervision.
Learning Objectives: Sustainable Finance Risks and EU Regulation Explain the key environmental, social and
Sustainable Finance Reporting, Governance and Risk Management Describe the European Sustainability Reporting
sections.Syllabus:
**Workshop 1** — Sustainable Finance Risks and EU Regulation Explain the key environmental, social and governance risks that impact financial products and services Describe the process of undertaking a sustainability risk assessment Identify greenwashing and greenbleaching practices Discuss the EU’s regulatory framework for sustainable finance, including the SFDR, CSRD and CSDDD

**Workshop 2** — Sustainable Finance Reporting, Governance and Risk Management Describe the European Sustainability Reporting Standards and contrast these with other international reporting frameworks Explain how to supervise ESG risk management and product governance in firms Identify the implications of sustainability risk for supervised entities Discuss how sustainable finance can be integrated into day-to-day supervision Explore future changes to the EU’s regulatory framework for sustainable finance
sections.Structure and Format: Delivered as a two-workshop series. Format: class discussion and case studies.
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some familiarity with sustainable finance in practice is helpful but not essential.

related.title: Sustainable Finance and ESG Supervision
related.summary: A ten-module programme equipping supervisors to assess ESG and climate risk, sustainability disclosures and product claims, and to integrate sustainable finance into day-to-day supervision.

related.title: Digital Operational Resilience under DORA (EU Edition)
related.summary: An eight-module programme on DORA for supervisors and financial entities: ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing and TLPT, ICT third-party risk and critical provider oversight.

related.title: EU Asset Management and Investment Fund Regulation (EU Edition)
related.summary: A ten-module programme mapping EU fund and asset management regulation, from UCITS, AIFMD and MiFID II to liquidity, delegation, cross-border marketing, SFDR and DORA.
